summary: Rebuilt all three documents against the bytes the four accepted reviews now hold after the upstream repair of STALE-STUDY-REVIEW: the 38-page expansive study (0edcc07c76da6c29affb30dfad7431d166f370e4b450818ea66336276bed2967), the 12-page concise study (689f6e31fa5fe237711ccf3759ba4f24d92be6381aebccb7f015bb238fa0638a) and the 5-page homily (65ddd79b4a6d37f96687a14a3f5ae27b7f9b01acacc227dbae896f66585a2c31). Each settles in exactly two passes, and a cold build from a fully removed auxiliary set and a warm build from the settled one produced byte-identical PDFs, auxiliary files and contents file, so these are a fixed point. All three logs are clean (no error, no LaTeX or package warning, no overfull or underfull box, no rerun request); PDF structure, metadata, font embedding (every face embedded, subsetted and Unicode-mapped) and text extraction all check out, Ghostscript renders every page without a diagnostic, and no page is blank or heading-only. The page counts satisfy the 20-50 and 10-12 ranges, and the concise auxiliary file settles the physical-page markers at absolute pages: inventory, overview and all four sense markers on 1, chronology on 2, themes 3 to 4, commentary beginning on 5. No layout repair was required, so no render source, revision timestamp or content seal was touched; the only working-tree changes are the snapshot the helper replaced at research/artifacts.json and the iteration-1 production audit appended to research/production-review.md. The artifacts-phase gate command, the per-edition component checks and the leaf content preflight all pass, and 55 bounded page rasters with 4 contact sheets are prepared in this stage's raster child, with the PDFs, logs, auxiliary files, extracted text and their digests kept beside it. Every review seal is now current: the research, study, synthesis and homily seals each hash exactly as their accepted review recorded them, and the format.tex staleness that failed the gate at iteration 0 is gone, repaired at its owner rather than restamped here. Compared with the reviewed proofs the homily PDF and all three auxiliary files are byte-identical, and the study and concise PDFs differ only in the printed Last revised colophon line that the homily stage's later shared timestamp moved. Nothing is installed and no page has had an independent visual review.
